## Research fields

Development economics &middot; urban and regional economics &middot; political
economy &middot; spatial economics. Methods: causal inference, staggered
difference-in-differences, spatial econometrics, applied microeconometrics.

## Teaching and training

Certified public procurement facilitator (LKPP), foundation and advanced level,
since 2018. Certified competency assessor (LSP LKPP / BNSP) for competency
levels 2–4, since 2020. [Details →](teaching.qmd)

## Professional experience

Civil servant, Government of North Sulawesi Province, since 2015. Roles include
commitment-making official, procurement official, procurement strategy analyst,
and member of provincial procurement selection working groups.
[Full history →](professional.qmd)

## Public procurement

Probity advisor and contract support team member, National Public Procurement
Agency (LKPP), since 2020. Certified mediator under the Supreme Court of the
Republic of Indonesia. Certificate Professional in Public Procurement (CPPP),
World Bank. Certified auditor, BPKP. [Full profile →](procurement/index.qmd)

## Professional service

Secretary, North Sulawesi chapter, Ikatan Ahli Pengadaan Indonesia (2024–2027).
Head of Procurement Competency Development, North Sulawesi chapter (2020–2023).
Provincial Coordinator for North Sulawesi, Forum Ahli Kontrak Pemerintah
Indonesia.

## Skills

**Software.** Stata, R, Python, QGIS, LaTeX.

**Empirical.** Staggered difference-in-differences and modern DiD estimators,
spatial econometrics, panel data methods, large-scale survey and administrative
microdata, raster and vector GIS processing, record linkage across changing
administrative boundaries.

**Languages.** Indonesian (native), English (professional working proficiency).
